notes.subject: פרץ נחל מעם גר
notes.rationale: Famous crux: 'a stream breaks out from the sojourner' (KJV literal) vs 'he breaks open a shaft away from where men sojourn' (ASV/JPS, miners digging)

notes.subject: דלו
notes.rationale: From דלל 'hang/be feeble' vs from דלה 'draw up' — 'they dangle' vs 'they are drawn up' (as water/men)

translation: Em i brukim wara bilong vali i go ausait long ples man i save stap, ol ples ol i lusim ting long ol fut; ol i hang long we na i seniseni i go long we long ol man.
